prompt: A 40-year-old man presents with mild dyspnea. His HR is 103 bpm, oxygen saturation is 98%, he has no hemoptysis, no estrogen use, no prior DVT/PE, no unilateral leg swelling, and no recent surgery. Does he meet PERC criteria to rule out PE?

rubric_items.text: States the patient does not meet PERC criteria to rule out PE (exact or equivalent wording acceptable; HR ≥100 is a positive PERC criterion).
